data.jd_text:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Project Director**
**The Company**
 WPP Production is a fast growing division of WPP group. WPP Production is headquartered in London but is present in many markets around the world, working through three global hubs (Singapore, New York and London) and with customer service and production facilities in multiple countries across every continent.
   

  

 WPP Production is an expert provider of marketing communications and advertising production services across Broadcast, Print and Digital media with a full suite of services that can take a creative advertising or promotional concept and deliver it, translated and culturally adapted, in whatever the required medium into every target market in the world, with better turnaround times, higher quality, more functional technology and more effective return on production investment than any competitive offering.
   

  

 Our clients are the world’s leading brands in consumer goods, financial services, automotive and electronics and we therefore compete in markets that demand the absolute highest standards of quality, customer care, reliability and value.
   

  

 Culturally, we seek to combine the entrepreneurial enthusiasm and creativity of an agency start up with the standards and delivery of a world\-class professional services business.
   

  

 We are a culturally diverse organization in a period of transition. We currently have around 2,300 full time employees representing the results of 8 years of continuous growth since start up.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a passionate leader and technical champion for the creation of rich front\-end experiences.
   

  

 You will manage a team of HTML5, Javascript, CSS developers and be ultimately responsible for the clients’ technical delivery.
   

  

 You have an in\-depth knowledge of current and emerging front\-end technologies and can work with server\-side technical leads to create and integrate complex client\-side applications. You will have a clear idea of what ‘good’ looks like, and be able to communicate best practice to your colleagues and fellow project members. You will work with WPP Production and partner organisations to define the optimum technical approach for client projects and ceaselessly promote best practice, quality and craft in your code and the code of those you lead.
   

  

 Strong communication skills, including the ability to listen, understand, advocate, and persuade are essential as you will represent your practice in client and internal senior stakeholder meetings.
   

  

 You will Provide technical thought leadership and promote the vision, strategy and services of the digital department to both educate our teams within Hogarth and to be seen as a leading figure in the industry.
   

  

 Define our distributed development strategy and processes across our onshore, offshore and remote teams, including identifying and developing key strategic technology partnerships.
   

  

 You will manage a team of highly skilled developers ranging from Graduate to Senior level, implementing and maintaining development practices, running meetings and workshops that ensure the growth, motivation and continued development of the team, and ultimately take responsibility for the quality of your team’s output.
   

  

 The team needs to build/modify responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc. based on the visual briefs.
   

  

 You will work closely with other discipline leads (QA/PM) to ensure scoping, estimates, and requirements are estimated correctly and delivered with minimal errors.
   

  

 You must be enthusiastic about technology and constantly be looking at the next innovation. On top of possessing strong oral, interpersonal, and organizational abilities, you must be able to work in a fast paced environment. Flexibility and tolerance is a necessity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Co\-ordinating with leads across key delivery teams (Tech, Project Management, QA, and Resource Management)
* Ensure compliance with WPP production processes
* Acting as the point of escalation for project issues raised by team leads, resolving problems quickly and communicating effectively
* Coaching and developing the team in their roles with regular performance reviews to ensure success in their personal development
* Manage the team hiring and keeping briefs clear and consistently updated
* Interviewing candidates for the team and taking responsibility for the approval of freelancers to work in a fast paced and reactive environment
* Set and manage client expectations while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
* Build strong, trusting relationships with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross\-functional project managers, senior managers, and third\-party vendors that are directly involved with the work
* Manage the approval of quarterly budgets, flagging important budget fluctuations to the client and line manager
* Draft, prepare and present timelines, documents, and presentations and reports both to the client and to the team
* Ensure that the line manager is always aware of all client issues and proposed solutions (including potential delays) to ensure swift resolution and avoid further escalation
* Ensure your account consistently delivers against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
* Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are followed
* Keep GAD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* teamwork, create balanced work schedule and ensure people are able to deliver results
* Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
* Plan resources for overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
* Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters


**Requirements**
* A minimum of 10 years Project Management experience background
* Experience of leading innovation, leveraging emerging platforms and quickly facilitating new ideas and platforms to market
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills
* Know\-how in working cross\-functionally to build relationships between business units, technology, product, media, agency, and design teams
* Experience working on international initiatives \- ideally with exposure to emerging markets
* Self\-motivated and a self\-starter
* Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
* Extensive experience in costing, quotations and project scope definition


* Excellent communication skills to different target groups within the project team, management and clients
* Ensure understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
* Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking
* Pragmatic, team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Understanding of brands and brand challenges
* The ability to function productively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* High level of IT literacy, including use of spreadsheets
* Strong numeracy skills
* Support GAD/CSD and FD in revenue forecasting on an ongoing basis
* Keep GAD/CSD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* Ensure full compliance with all financial procedure and policies
* Prioritization, time management and attention to detail
* Resilience and ability to work under pressure
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, in both Arabic and English
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Highly organised, detail oriented, customer focused, and proactive
* Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:
+ iOS and Android development
+ Cloud computing
+ HTML5/CSS/JavaScript
+ ecommerce/Shopping Carts
+ Social Media Strategies/Platforms

* Familiarity with creative production and development tools is always an advantage. Such software includes Adobe Creative Suite, BBEdit, SVN, GitHub, Eclipse, Dreamweaver, Final Cut Pro and others. In addition, familiarity with mobile and web platforms and ecosystems would also be advantageous
* Must be able to travel as required, sometimes for several weeks at a time


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
   

  

**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



**Are you ready to lead from the front?** 




 Anaplan is on a mission to revolutionise business planning, and our Presales team is the engine of that ambition. We are looking for a visionary and strategic leader to take the helm of our high\-performing Solution Consulting team in the UAE.
 



 This isn't just a management role; it's a chance to be a pivotal member of the EMEA Go\-To\-Market and EMEA Presales leadership teams. You will be the architect of our regional success, empowering a team of up to 8 brilliant individuals to push boundaries, challenge the status quo, and drive customer success. If you thrive in a culture that embraces diverse perspectives and rewards bold ideas, we want to hear from you.
 



**Your Impact** 




 You won't just be managing a team; you'll be building a legacy. As a business partner to our sales leaders, you will:
 


* **Shape the Vision:** 
  Craft and execute a winning regional strategy for the Solution Consulting team, aligning your vision with our EMEA and global goals.
* **Drive Transformational Change:** 
 Act as a change agent, driving operational excellence and transforming the Germany Solution Consulting team to new heights of performance and agility.
* **Master the Business:** 
  Take ownership of the regional Book of Business, ensuring tight account alignment and accountability across your team to maximise our impact.
* **Lead with Agility:** 
  Proactively partner with regional sales teams to strategically allocate Presales resources, pivot engagement strategies, and drive a winning momentum.
* **Build a World\-Class Team:** 
  Be a magnet for top talent. You will hire, mentor, and develop a team of high\-readiness professionals, defining clear career paths to foster retention and growth.
* **Forge Key Relationships:** 
 Make a direct impact on our UKI business by building unshakeable trust and credibility with key stakeholders at our most strategic customers and partners.



**Your Qualifications** 




 You are a leader who can both strategise from 30,000 feet and execute flawlessly on the ground. You bring:
 


* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
  Hands\-on knowledge of SaaS applications.
* Specific experience in EPM/CPM\-based technologies, preferably around FP\&A or Supply Chain platforms (preferred).
* **Proven Presales Leadership:** 
  Demonstrable experience managing and inspiring a team of individual Presales contributors while navigating a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales environment. Ideally you will have grown and managed a team in the region.
* **Regional Experience:** 
 A track record of successfully managing a team in UAE or the middle East.
* **A Change\-Maker's Mindset:** 
  You have led teams through transformation and are comfortable driving and managing change.
* **A Player\-Coach Mentality:** 
  The ability to both lead and execute, rolling up your sleeves to help your team win.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



 If you're ready to make your mark and lead a team at the forefront of business transformation, let's talk.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Technology Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the technology and artificial intelligence sector in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on advancing corporate governance; ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and governance\-enabled innovation amongst technology actors and investors. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organization by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
* Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
* Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
* Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
* Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Mentor and coach Programme Associate, providing timely and actionable feedback, creating teachable opportunities, and offering programme career guidance.
* Define and monitor the development plan of Programme Associate, with regular pulse checks, ensuring time and any needed resources are allocated for training.
* Enable career growth, including promotions, for Programme Associate.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.



  





**Qualifications and experience** 



* A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, and / or the social sciences, or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
* Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, data governance, impact measurement, or technology management are highly desirable.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in managing, coordinating, and executing programs, academic institutions, think tanks, research centers, member\-based networks/councils, or non\-profit organizations.
* Work experience in the private sector, including tech companies, startups, or entrepreneurial ventures is highly desirable.
* Work experience in governance in the tech sector is highly desirable, with a deep understanding of governance and impact frameworks, regulatory compliance, and sustainability practices in the industry.
* Demonstrated experience leading in business development, revenue generation, and / or fundraising for programmes, projects, and / or initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver programmes independently while managing and building relationships with multiple senior market stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
* Demonstrated acumen in AI governance, ethical AI, and emerging regulations in AI/technology, including familiarity with frameworks like ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System), GDPR, and responsible AI practices.
* Expertise in research, impact analysis, impact\-driven programme development, and curriculum design is highly desirable.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a portfolio of published writings is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in Arabic is highly desirable.



  





**Personal attributes** 



* Self\-initiator and self\-learner
* Emotional and social intelligence
* Strategic and solutions\-driven
* Passionate about subject area
* Hardworking and meticulous
* Natural leader and team manager
* Collaborative and adaptive
* Open and transparent communicator
* Purposeful and driven by impact
* Strong work ethic embodying good governance and integrity

We are currently looking for a Associate Director for the Eyewear Distribution group in the UAE .
 



**Job Description** 



* Lead the development and execution of regional sales and business growth strategies to achieve revenue targets, profitability objectives, and market share expansion across the MENA region.
* Drive strategic business planning through market intelligence, competitive analysis, and identification of emerging trends and growth opportunities.
* Oversee the evaluation, selection, and market positioning of assigned eyewear brands and collections to maximize commercial potential.
* Establish and implement distribution strategies to ensure optimal brand presence across key retail channels while safeguarding brand equity and positioning.
* Build, mentor, and lead high\-performing sales teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and results\-driven performance.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with brand principals, key accounts, retailers, and other business partners.
* Identify and negotiate new business opportunities, partnerships, and expansion initiatives to accelerate growth.
* Ensure effective inventory planning and stock management across assigned territories to support sales objectives and minimize supply disruptions.

* Lead negotiations to secure premium retail visibility, dedicated brand spaces, window displays, and other high\-impact promotional opportunities.
* Monitor sales performance, market dynamics, and customer trends, providing strategic recommendations to optimize business performance.
* Prepare and present business reviews, sales forecasts, market analysis, and strategic reports to senior management and brand partners.
* Collaborate closely with marketing, brand management, retail operations, warehousing, logistics, and finance teams to ensure alignment of commercial objectives and business priorities.
* Lead product knowledge, brand, and sales training initiatives for retail teams and key stakeholders to enhance brand advocacy and customer engagement.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, commercial governance standards, and brand principal requirements across all markets.



**Requirement:** 



* Bachelor's Degree or Postgraduate Qualification in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
* Arabic language proficiency (spoken and written) is highly preferred.
* Minimum 10–15 years of sales, distribution, or commercial management experience within the GCC region, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Experience within the eyewear, luxury, fashion, FMCG, or consumer goods sectors is preferred.
* Proven track record of delivering sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic account development.
* Strong leadership, people management, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
* Excellent commercial acumen, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build strategic partnerships and manage relationships with international brand principals.
* Strong analytical and financial planning skills with experience managing budgets, forecasts, and performance metrics.
* Valid UAE Driving License.
* Willingness to travel extensively across MENA region.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You Will Need For This Position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**

data.jd_text:
**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.
* Flexible and adaptable, with willingness to work according to project and industry requirements.
* Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and contractual interfaces across complex project environments.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual Flight Allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Vice President, Operations \& Systems, is responsible for defining and executing the P\&T operational systems vision, architecture, and roadmap for all operational systems across the P\&T Pillar. This executive role ensures that operational technology platforms, software applications, integrations, and digital solutions align with business objectives, operational excellence goals, and long\-term growth strategies.
   

  

 The VP leads the development of system strategies, functional and technical specifications, roadmaps, and implementation plans while working closely with business leaders, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership. The role is accountable for maximizing business value through technology innovation, standardization, automation, and scalable digital solutions.
   

  

* Develop and maintain the P\&T strategy for operational systems and software platforms.
* Define the long\-term vision, target architecture, and digital transformation roadmap for operational technologies.
* Align technology initiatives with corporate strategy, operational objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Act as the executive sponsor for major operational technology and software transformation programs.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies, automation, AI, analytics, IoT, and digital operations.
* Establish governance frameworks for operational systems, software selection, architecture standards, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, and standardization across operational platforms.
* Define system ownership models, decision\-making processes, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Provide guidance to Business Units, Regional offices and HO with regards to all in\-house P\&T Systems (Zodiac, CCS, Rostering, Oracle, Maximo, Smart Solutions, Business Analytics) and other related technology across Ports and Terminals.
* Implement guidelines, processes, procedures for Terminal Operating Systems smart applications, system utilisation and fine tuning, quality and productivity, over the entire portfolio of terminals.
* Promote collaboration and best practice sharing amongst Business units, setting up TOS user groups and form a centralized TOS knowledge base for system implementation, testing and system migration. Assist the Business Units in selecting and implementing the right systems and related periphery technologies.
* Ensure accurate data collection from each P\&T business across the DP World Portfolio.
* Oversee successful integration globally of all in\-house P\&T Systems.
* Ultimately responsible for successful and customer service issue free go\-live of P\&T systems.Managing and ensuring fluid movement between ideation and project delivery stage, delivering a committed portfolio of Innovation projects and programs that add value.
* Deliver solutions to DP World Group challenges in all disciplines.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain multi\-year operational systems roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities, capability gaps, modernization opportunities, and future technology requirements.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment, while monitoring technology trends and recommending strategic investments.
* Define and oversee implementation strategies for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring successful program execution and a smooth transition into operational support and continuous improvement.
* Lead organizational change, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, and user readiness strategies to support successful implementation and sustained value realization.
* Establish enterprise architecture principles and technology standards for operational systems, including cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises solutions where appropriate.
* Ensure seamless integration between operational systems, ERP platforms, customer\-facing applications, data platforms, and third\-party solutions, promoting data consistency, interoperability, scalability, and real\-time information sharing.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into business cases, functional specifications, technical requirements, and solution designs.
* Ensure operational systems and solution designs support current and future business processes while meeting security, compliance, reliability, performance, and design integrity requirements.
* Lead evaluation, selection, and management of software vendors and technology partners for Ports \& Terminals, including negotiation of strategic agreements, monitoring of performance and innovation roadmaps, and management of contractual obligations.
* Govern the commercial and contractual relationship between business units and internal/external system providers.
* Ensure operational systems comply with cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, and industry standards, and identify, assess, and mitigate technology\-related operational risks.
* Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical operational systems.
* Standardize processes and align key performance indicators to reduce customization across system implementations and improve consistency across disciplines.
* Support comparison, selection, and implementation of operational systems and technologies across the Ports \& Terminals portfolio.
* Assess TOS utilization effectiveness across business units and strengthen adoption through training recommendations in collaboration with DP World Hub and relevant learning tools.
* Direct the development roadmap of the internal TOS, Zodiac, in alignment with the global TOS strategy.
* Manage TOS and peripheral technology vendor relationships from a central head office perspective, including regular user groups to build alignment, knowledge sharing, and operational adoption.
* Advise senior management on AFE for P\&T Systems.
* Act as liaison and quality control point for collecting business requirements for operational system implementations and system enhancements.
* Maintain relationships with all third\-party service providers and vendors supporting operational systems and technology.
* Direct and improve the Group’s Innovation portfolio, strengthening innovation maturity across all pillars, including Ports \& Terminals, Logistics, Digital Solutions, and Marine.
* Champion an innovation culture across DP World by encouraging idea generation, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new solutions across all pillars.
* Measure the impact of innovation outcomes on DP World’s business, including value creation, cost savings, customer satisfaction, and human safety and wellbeing.
* Direct the groupwide Innovation Platform (INNOGATE) development roadmap and ensure innovative projects and solutions are integrated into commercial, marketing, supply chain, and operational processes.
* Manage geographically dispersed and functionally diverse internal and external teams to maintain a single view of the innovation portfolio and ensure effective delivery.
* Stay abreast of industry and technology trends and market developments, and make recommendations to DP World accordingly.


**Education**

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Logistics, Technology Management, Computer Science or related field. Master's degree (MBA, Technology Management, Logistics, Engineering, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 Experience in managing the terminal business.
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in terminal operations, enterprise software, operational systems, digital transformation, or technology leadership roles.
* 8\+ years in senior leadership positions managing large\-scale technology portfolios and transformation programs.
* Proven experience defining technology strategy, roadmaps, architecture, and implementation plan for complex operational environments.
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide software implementations and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of operational technology platforms, enterprise applications, integration architectures, cloud technologies, and data platforms.
* Experience in global container/non\-container terminal industry with a keen interest in TOS planning, implementations, and optimization.
* Experience in terminal automation and the various modes of operation, ASC/RTG/RMG/SC
* Business leader with proven track record of change management.


 Is widely recognised and respected and well known to BU and regional leadership.

 utive management.

**About Us**
 Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.
   

  

 With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.
   

  

 We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses \-\- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end\-to\-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.
   

  

 What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.
   

  

 DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.
   

  

 We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

 DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programmess of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi\-faceted jeweled bottles.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative \& luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Director of Manufacturing \& Procurement leads Kayali's external manufacturing, procurement, and quality functions, owning the end\-to\-end journey from supplier sourcing, through industrialization at contract manufacturers, to the delivery of finished, compliant product. Reporting to the Global VP of Operations, this role leads the Purchasing and Quality teams as its operating core, while building the industrialization and external\-manufacturing capability Kayali needs to scale across new geographies.
   

  

 2026 \- 2028 are build years. The role will lead Kayali's conversion from toll to contract manufacturing, the launch of a new external manufacturing partner, and the establishment of business continuity planning across the full supplier base. Design authority for formula and packaging sits with Product Development; this role owns making it, at scale, on cost, and to standard.
   

  

* Strategic Leadership \& Operational Excellence
* Define and drive the vision for Kayali's external manufacturing, procurement, and quality operations, aligned to the brand's global expansion
* Shift the operating model from a reactive to a proactive footing, embedding forward\-looking planning and risk anticipation into the manufacturing, procurement, and quality strategy and roadmap
* Lead operational transformation, including the toll\-to\-contract manufacturing conversion and the multi\-region external network build
* Develop risk\-mitigation and business continuity plans that ensure supply resilience across all suppliers and geographies
* Build high\-value partnerships with contract manufacturers and suppliers to optimise cost, quality, and scalability
* Procurement \& Supplier Management
* Lead the Purchasing team and own the strategic sourcing roadmap across direct materials, indirect goods and services, and contract\-manufactured finished goods


 Manage the shift in commercial model from component buying (toll) to finished\-goods cost management (contract), including should\-cost and open\-book negotiation and margin transparency with Finance.
   

  

* Lead supplier negotiations, contracts, and performance management, balancing cost, quality, and continuity
* Drive value engineering and supplier innovation to enhance product competitiveness
* Quality \& Compliance
* Lead the Quality team and the global quality assurance strategy for externally manufactured product
* Establish supplier\-quality and audit capability to qualify and govern new contract manufacturers across regions
* Ensure full regulatory compliance across geographies, including GMP, ISO, IFRA, and REACH, and US requirements such as MoCRA facility and product obligations and TTB / denatured\-alcohol controls
* Own product\-integrity and illicit\-trade risk: controlled and denatured\-alcohol inputs, restricted aroma chemicals, anti\-counterfeit and grey\-market mitigation, and the secure destruction of non\-conforming and obsolete stock so it cannot enter illicit channels
* Define and track quality KPIs aligned across internal teams and external partners
* Manufacturing Network \& Industrialization
* Build and own Kayali's external manufacturing network: site\-selection support, qualification, validation, audit, and ramp\-up, starting with the new US partner and the Asia pipeline
* Own industrialization and technology transfer from PD design handoff through scaled production, including pilot and first\-article batches and launch\-readiness gates
* Lead the toll\-to\-contract technology and BOM transfer across the contract\-manufacturing base
* Optimise manufacturability, lead times, and production cost within the design parameters set by Product Development
* Establish data\-driven production and network performance tracking
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration (Product Development \& Finance)
* Product Development: serve as PD's industrialization partner. Receive design handoffs, feed back manufacturability constraints, and co\-own the design\-to\-production gate. PD retains authority over formula and packaging design
* Finance: partner on standard costing, COGS, margin, business cases, and capital decisions for the manufacturing network; own the operational inputs to financial planning
* Act as the connective tissue across PD, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial to ensure seamless launch execution
* Project \& Program Management
* Lead manufacturing, procurement, and quality programs end to end: charters, stage gates, RACI, timelines, budgets, and risk logs
* Run the toll\-to\-contract conversion, US factory launch, and BCP rollout as governed programs with clear milestones and reporting
* Manage concurrent workstreams and cross\-functional dependencies, surfacing risk early with clear options
* Leadership \& Organizational Development
* Build, mentor, and inspire a high\-performing team across procurement, quality, and industrialization
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence
* Develop succession planning and leadership development to grow future talent within Kayali


**Requirements**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field. MBA a plus.
   

  

* 10\+ years in manufacturing operations, procurement, or supply chain, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role in the beauty/fragrance industry
* Proven experience managing outsourced / contract manufacturing networks, ideally in fragrance, cosmetics, or consumer goods
* Direct experience with toll\-to\-contract or contract\-manufacturing model transitions strongly preferred
* Strong project and program management track record; PMP or equivalent a plus
* Demonstrated cross\-functional leadership, particularly with Product Development and Finance
* Financial acumen: should\-costing, COGS, margin, and business\-case development
* Experience managing product\-integrity and illicit\-trade risk, including controlled and denatured\-alcohol inputs (e.g. US TTB / SDA permitting and diversion controls), restricted aroma chemicals, anti\-counterfeit and grey\-market mitigation, and secure destruction of non\-conforming stock
* Working knowledge of multi\-geography regulatory compliance (GMP, ISO, IFRA, REACH; US MoCRA an advantage)
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies


**Benefits**
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* Find Your Magic Days
* Volunteer Day
* Professional Development Days
* Birthday leave
* Egg Freezing Benefits
* Employee discounts on Kayali products
* Quarterly product gifting


 Kayali is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know
