data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes general responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade engineering and deisgn capabilities across the globe.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for Façade and all other disciplines. You may lead, develop, and manage a team of up to 5 direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Façade Designer:
   

  




* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Director. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high\-quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables
* Help solve client/project team’s problems by lateral thinking and creating innovative solutions
* Ensure quality outputs and agreed cost/scheduled delivery time frames are met
* Manage projects, site meetings, design workshops and site inspection as required and/or as project planning stipulates
* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other disciplines.
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)
* Oversee engineering computations and structural façade analysis, advice and reporting
* Meet with architects to develop façade design concepts, detailing, specifications, and engineering feasibility and coordinate with other project consultants such as Builders, Contractors and Sub Contractors to determine best practice façade design outcomes
* Write and review specifications and schedules to inform and respond to site and construction related queries
* Review and comment on sub\-contractor’s shop drawings \& calculations, BD submission drawings, fabrication drawings \& material submission
* Follow the general drawing protocols and cad file system set by Inhabit
* Provide assistance during construction of façade systems including attendance mock\-up testing, shop drawing reviews and conduct factory \& site inspections



**Technical Excellence**




 The Associate shall assume full responsibility for work quality undertaken and ensure quality is adhered to by performing regular checks of your direct reports work and a senior peer review role on projects, including:
   

  




* Ensure project specific technical duties including engineering, design and project lead roles are effectively managed
* Identification of technically complex projects and problems that require high level input
* Undertake provision of concept design, peer review and checking services on projects to assist in maintaining high standards
* Provide technical assistance and grow the team’s capability relating to the weatherproofing and installation of various façade systems
* Assist in developing and growing the BIM capability of the office in conjunction with other team members, aligning Inhabit’s capabilities with market expectations\\
* Take necessary action to prevent the occurrence of design documentation and/or quality system non\-conformity
* Ensure all project documentation is maintained to a level as required by Inhabits’ QA Manager and QA system
* Endorse and facilitate the quality management system (QMS) and the Business’s commitment to quality
* Conduct all activities in accordance with the quality management system



**Personal Attributes:**



* Attitude and participation towards project, client, team
* Motivation in role
* Sense of urgency when appropriate
* Confidence in role amongst team and clients
* Desire to achieve high standards, set goals or targets
* Overall commitment to your position
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* How you apply new skills
* Team interaction
* Willingness to help others



**Role Capability Profile**




**Quality \& Quantity of Work:**



* Assures accuracy, thoroughness and reliability of results
* Meets the workload requirements of the job
* Is proficient in technical skills required for the job
* Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of the knowledge required to complete job responsibilities



**Decisions:**



* Conducts thorough analysis before making decisions
* Makes sound, logical and timely decisions



**Planning \& Time Management:**



* Develops \& implements effective action plans
* Meets deadlines as required
* Maintains performance under pressure
* Timesheet efficiency (weekly submission)



**Performance Management:**



* Achieves own objectives
* Delegates appropriate tasks to appropriate people
* Gives employees adequate information \& authority
* Follows up progress on delegated projects
* Provides ongoing feedback and training to employees where relevant



**Initiative:**



* Displays initiative in the position and does not seek unnecessary clarification or instruction
* Generates and implements worthwhile, practical new ideas and methods
* Responds effectively to changing needs of the workplace



**Relationships:**



* Interacts appropriately with customers/clients, both internally and externally
* Displays good interpersonal skills
* Uses appropriate style to resolve conflict with people at all levels
* Acts in best interest of the organisation



**Communication:**



* Listens attentively, demonstrates full understanding
* Oral and written – expresses ideas effectively
* Quality of presentations
* Preparation of internal and external correspondence



  

  





**Personal Attributes:**



* Attitude and participation towards project, client, team
* Motivation in role
* Sense of urgency when appropriate
* Confidence in role amongst team and clients
* Desire to achieve high standards, set goals or targets
* Overall commitment to your position
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* How you apply new skills

* Willingness to help others


**Qualifications**

 Bachelor of Architecture or Bachelor of Engineering is preferable.
   

  





 The candidate shall have a minimum of 10 years' experience in a facade role.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**Other Requirements**



* Correctly use and maintain Personal Protective Equipment provided
* Takes reasonable care for the safety of his/her own health and safety and that of other people who may be affected by their conduct in the workplace
* Seek guidance for all new or modified work procedures to ensure that any hazardous conditions, near misses and injures are reported immediately to Management
* Participate in compliance training and other environment, health and safety activities as required
* Abide by the Code of Conduct; this is a minimum standard of behaviour that must be upheld by all employees
* In addition to the duties set out in this Position Description, you may be expected to perform such other duties as may from time to time be reasonably assigned to you by the Employer



**Other Relevant Information**



* Travel to various work locations throughout Middle East may be required

data.jd_text:
**Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation** 




**Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA** 









**Objective** 




  





 The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) \- Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects.
 



  





**Job responsibility** 




  





**Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions)** 



* Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions.
* Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs.
* Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand\-over to execution: pre\-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies…
* Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O\&M Contracts etc...
* Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors
* Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor.
* Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design.
* Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents.
* In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical\-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s).
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation.
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O\&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O\&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O\&M philosophy...
* Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project.
* Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close.
* Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams
* Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O\&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews.
* Support the negotiations with the contractors.
* Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities.
* Prepares the technical hand\-over for execution stage.
* Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration.



  





**New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead** 



* Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research \& Innovation (R\&I) programmes and community
* Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics
* Maintains a technology watch
* Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing



**Lead on Engagement of Third\-Party Engineering Consultants** 



* Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors)
* Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects



**Qualification/Experience** 



* Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
* Experience in projects technical development.
* Experience in bid preparation.
* Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT).
* Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus.
* Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS…
* Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms.
* Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O\&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts...
* Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team.
* Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage.
* Experience in desalination will be an advantage.
* Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage.



**Character and Skills** 



* Pro\-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them
* Organized and rigorous
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds
* Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage.



  





  





 ENGIE group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
 



 ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy\-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.

 Clients

data.jd_text:
Executive Assistant — Middle East
 **(Maternity Cover)**




  





***About the Role***




 This is an exciting opportunity to join a
 **top\-tier international law firm** 
 in a key role within its Middle East team. The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East, bringing substantial EA experience gained within an international law firm based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
 



  





 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
 



  





***Roles and Responsibilities***




  





**Executive Support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Proactively manage the Head's complex, high\-volume diary, scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Act as gatekeeper, triaging meeting requests, queries and issues, and redirecting them appropriately while ensuring matters are resolved effectively.
* Prepare agendas, attend meetings the Head is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and follow up with action owners to ensure timely completion.
* Attend meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head where appropriate, independently managing follow\-up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
* Prepare briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to support strategic and commercial decision\-making.
* Anticipate information needs and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams ahead of key meetings or decisions.



  





**Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation** 



* Arrange end\-to\-end complex travel, including multi\-destination international itineraries, transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
* Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction\-specific requirements.
* Provide strategic input into travel planning, combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
* Liaise with colleagues across offices and functions to ensure a joined\-up, firm\-wide approach that maximises the value of each trip.
* Manage last\-minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently.
* Prepare detailed post\-trip reports covering meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities and next steps, and ensure all follow\-up actions are diarised and progressed.



  





**Marketing \& Business Development Support** 



* Manage speaking engagements and thought\-leadership commitments, tracking deadlines, coordinating research, and drafting materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
* Arrange briefing meetings ahead of panels, speaking slots or publications to ensure the Head is fully prepared.
* Liaise with the Knowledge team and internal stakeholders to obtain research and background material, ensuring contributions are accurate and high quality.
* Register the Head for events and prepare comprehensive pre\-event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives.
* Work with the Head and Business Development teams to maintain up\-to\-date client target lists, tracking status and ensuring assigned actions are progressed.
* Provide regular status updates on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against objectives.



  





**Billing, Finance \& Expenses** 



* Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head's matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
* Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance, and issue final invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
* Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head.
* Oversee expense submissions, liaising directly with vendors to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where needed.
* Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget\-holder approval in line with firm policy.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding invoices and payments, keeping the Head and the Billing and Finance teams fully informed.



  





**Performance \& People Processes** 



* Support the Head throughout the performance review process, scheduling review meetings in line with firm\-wide deadlines.
* Prepare review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
* Monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
* Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head during discussions.
* Support completion of post\-meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, and maintain oversight of outstanding actions.
* Maintain close, regular communication with HR throughout the review cycle, confirming deadlines and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.



  





**CRM \& Relationship Management** 



* Maintain and update the Head's contacts and relationship data in InterAction, accurately recording activities, meetings and notes.
* Support the Head in managing effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers across jurisdictions.
* Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring they are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
* Ensure referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow\-up on agreed actions and opportunities.



  





**Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison** 



* Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and updating the Head regularly.
* Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations) to ensure strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of regional initiatives.
* Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings to keep all functions informed, aligned and engaged, agreeing deliverables and capturing activities, deadline changes and requirements for the Head's radar.
* Ensure key outputs feed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings.



  





**Person Specification** 



* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or in a similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi\-time\-zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
* Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi\-destination itineraries, visas and short\-notice changes.
* Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparing draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
* Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
* Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
* Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to draft correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
* Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
* Professional, client\-focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior stakeholders and clients.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

As the Director of Technical Services, you will be responsible for the strategy and execution of technical services by employees of the Services Department in various FreeBalance Customer locations throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Responsibilities include building technical strategies, models, and approaches with team members operating out of the Headquarters of FreeBalance in Ottawa and ensuring its implementation and execution with all FreeBalance Technical Consultants overseas. This position is part of the Services Leadership team that works with the Solution Team in Ottawa and overseas (mainly in the EMEA region) alongside the individual project managers who manage the entire lifecycle of the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that addresses the Public Financial Management reform that FreeBalance customers undertake and implement.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Preparation of strategies and design for data migration that can be implemented by the FreeBalance Technical Consultants at a client location.
* Build tools and models for the Installation and Deployment of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite that can be leveraged for project deliveries.
* Collaborate with the Research and Development Team to design the interface components during the implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite.
* Collaborate with the Technical and Functional Consultants to create the training curriculum that can be delivered to the customers.
* Manage the day\-to\-day tasks of the team.
* Work with the Project Managers to design the rollout of the system for decentralized operations.
* Managing the Operations \& maintenance team in EMEA and provide management oversight to the remote team worldwide.
* Manage the technical tools and research and develop new tools for use by the Technical Consultants.
* Build scalable models for implementation of the FreeBalance Accountability Suite at the Data Centre and Disaster Recovery Sites where the software is hosted.

* Other duties as assigned.

* University degree in Information Technology.
* Proven experience reviewing and developing Support and Maintenance policies and procedures.
* 5 years of experience successfully managing an internationally dispersed Services and Support Team

* Experience with goal\-setting frameworks like Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities
* Establish strategic direction across core domains: AI \& Data Platforms, ERP \& Enterprise Systems, Integration \& APIs, Digital Products, Service Orchestration
* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Evolved organisational awareness and stakeholder management



  





 Deep expertise across:
 



  




* AI \& Data Platforms (Foundry, MS Fabric, MLOPs)
* ERP Systems (Oracle)
* Integration Architecture (APIs, middleware, event\-driven systems)
* Digital Product Platforms (Webflow/Acquia)
* Service orchestration and platform operating models (ServiceNow)
* Experience blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and tokenisation frameworks, including their integration into enterprise platforms and digital product ecosystems
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and DevSecOps
* Ability to define and execute multi\-domain enterprise platform strategies



  





**Behavioural Competencies:** 




  




* Strong executive presence and influence at C\-suite level
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Results\-oriented with high accountability
* Proven ability to build and lead high\-performing teams



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates we believe in connecting the world to and through our global hub in Dubai and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers Fly Better.
   

  

 Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation were always at the forefront pushing boundaries. Were on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the worlds largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting edge information and technology team as an
 **Agile Delivery Lead \- Emiratisation.**
 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive the success at Emirates Group.
   

  

 As the
 **Agile Delivery Lead \- Emiratisation** 
 you will perform the role of Scrum Master developing and leading a high performing multidiscipline team instilling in them a clear vision and a passionate drive. They play a leading role in fulfilling the vision driving the implementation of technical products and setting standards for teams to follow. The Agile Delivery Lead is responsible for the day to day planning leading organising and motivating of the scrum teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to business users.
   

  

 This role blends Scrum Master responsibilities with traditional project management practices, ensuring structured planning, risk control, stakeholder alignment, and consistent delivery of business value. You will lead the delivery of technology initiatives by combining Agile leadership with strong project management discipline. You will build and guide high‑performing, multi‑disciplinary teams, instilling clear direction, delivery rigour, and a strong focus on outcomes. This role is central to translating strategic priorities into well‑planned, governed and successfully executed delivery.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Schedule user stories from the technical product backlog to the Sprint plan focusing on regular and timely delivery of business value initiatives and facilitating agile ceremonies eg product backlog refinement sprint planning daily stand ups sprint reviews and retrospectives
* Manage risks assumptions issues and dependencies removing impediments blockers to ensure optimal flow of value Guide the team on the use of Agile Scrum practices and values to delight the business and how to elicit the most out of self organization Assess the Scrum Maturity of the team and coach the team to higher levels of maturity at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team.
* Promotes empowerment of the team ensuring that each team member is fully engaged in the initiatives and is making a meaningful contribution and encourages a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team.
* Work collaboratively with the Technical Product Owners to refine clarify and maintain the product backlog together with the TPO schedules and commits stories into sprints and visualizes progress.
* Support the Technical Product Owners in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives.
* Define and manage a well defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management and effectively manage conflict resolution Ensure the Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done DOD is being followed and make sure that each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution.
* Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team Maintains an agile project management tool ScrumDesk JIRA etc.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours or equivalent in a subject related to Computer Science or similar.
* Certified Scrum Master with 3 years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline PMI ACP transition of existing SDCs are exempt.
* 5 years of working in Information Technology in agile delivery within the context of a small medium technology change program. Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Well versed in the use of tools of software delivery eg MS OFFICE suite JIRA Confluence etc.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent Communication Skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.

data.jd_text:
**BRANDSYSTEM** 





 We're an entrepreneurial group headquartered in Dubai (office based in Business Bay), and e\-commerce is what ties everything together. The group brings together five verticals built around that core: supply chain operations, consulting, owned brands, software products, and an incubator. Different models, different stages \- but a shared drive to build, deliver and grow.
 





 Today the group counts 8 businesses and 70 people. Most of these businesses are young and scaling fast. The Finance function is being built as the business scales \- structure and impact, at the same time.
 




  





**THE ROLE** 




**You'll be working directly alongside the Group Head of Finance \- together, you build the Finance function across the group.** 





 ·   
 

 Owning the production of the monthly consolidated reporting (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) \- the framework is still being constructed; target is D\+8 delivery with budget variance analysis for each entity
 





 ·   
 

 Driving the budget cycle alongside the Head of Finance \- continuously improving processes, driving reforecasts when needed, and leading the annual budget exercise for each business
 





 ·   
 

 Designing and implementing the weekly cash flow reporting per entity with the automation team \- then running it as a key input to management meetings
 





 ·   
 

 Embedding operational KPIs into each entity's P\&L \- making Finance speak the language of the business and delivering actionable insights to business teams
 





 ·   
 

 Supporting the set\-up of the Group's banking structure and Cash Pool
 





 ·   
 

 Monitoring and framing intercompany flows \- recharges, current accounts, management fees
 





 ·   
 

 Acting as the main point of contact for entity accountants \- coordinating, aligning, and ensuring the numbers are right
 





 ·   
 

 Ensuring data reliability across entities, working closely with the data and automation team to clean data at the source and automate reporting
 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 





 ·   
 

 2 to 3 years in FP\&A, audit, TAS, or corporate finance \- you know your way around a P\&L and you're not intimidated by a blank page
 





 ·   
 

 Grande École de Commerce, university master in Finance, or equivalent
 





 ·   
 

 Native French speaker, fluent in English \- French is the working language, English used with external partners
 





 ·   
 

 You build structure, you don't wait for it \- sharp on Excel; any FP\&A or BI tooling is a bonus
 





 ·   
 

 Some exposure to e\-commerce, retail, or high\-growth startups will make a difference
 




  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 





 ·   
 
 A genuine opportunity to build Finance from scratch across an entire group \- multiple businesses, multiple models
 




 ·   
 
 Concrete responsibilities from day one, with a direct impact on the business
 




 ·   
 
 A fast\-moving environment where the learning curve is steep and the pace keeps you sharp
 




 ·   
 
 A role designed to grow with you \- if you deliver, the scope expands
 




 ·   
 
 Competitive package, tax\-free \- health insurance, gym membership and one annual flight to home country covered

 Provide high‑level strategic, financial, governance, and performance advisory to the CEO’s Office. Lead integrated financial–strategic consulting workflows, strengthen financial and KPI frameworks, and steer cross‑domain financial and investment studies to support institutional direction.
 



 Provide advisory and support leadership in shaping long‑term strategy by delivering advanced financial assessments, feasibility analysis, investment evaluation, risk modelling, and financial impact assessments of strategic initiatives. Leverage AI, foresight, and analytics to enhance financial sustainability, resource allocation efficiency, and institutional value creation.

* Provide Authority/sector‑level strategic financial and corporate strategy advisory to the SCG CEO, including financial policy insights, investment analysis, and governance recommendations.

* Identify and mitigate institutional risks across safety, financial, operational, and reputational domains. Propose effective mitigation measures to safeguard organizational resilience

**Product/Process Improvement**

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Group Director of Security is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing the Group's security, safety, risk management, and loss prevention strategies across all TFG Hospitality properties. This role provides strategic leadership to ensure the safety and security of guests, employees, contractors, visitors, and company assets while maintaining compliance with corporate policies, legal requirements, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Leadership Team, the Group Director of Security partners closely with Operations, Human Resources, Engineering, Finance, IT, and General Managers to establish a proactive security culture, minimize operational risks, and ensure business continuity across the portfolio.
   

  

 The role requires exceptional leadership, sound judgment, crisis management expertise, and the ability to develop standardized security programs while adapting to the operational needs of individual properties.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategic Leadership
   

  

* Develop and execute the Group Security Strategy aligned with TFG Hospitality's business objectives.
* Establish, review, and continuously improve security, safety, and risk management policies across all properties.
* Standardize security operating procedures, emergency response protocols, and compliance requirements throughout the portfolio.
* Provide strategic advice and recommendations to Executive Leadership regarding emerging security risks and mitigation strategies.
* Benchmark security practices against industry standards and recommend improvements.


 Safety, Security \& Risk Management
   

  

* Oversee the implementation of all Safety, Security, Risk Management, and Loss Prevention programs across the Group.
* Develop strategies to protect company assets, guests, employees, contractors, and visitors.
* Ensure compliance with local legislation, health and safety regulations, fire life safety requirements, and corporate standards.
* Lead the Group's Threat and Vulnerability Assessment program and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Ensure all properties maintain effective emergency preparedness, business continuity, and crisis management plans.
* Conduct periodic security risk assessments and audits across all hotels and hospitality outlets.


 Crisis \& Emergency Management
   

  

* Lead the development, implementation, and regular review of Crisis Management and Emergency Response Plans.
* Serve as the Group's lead advisor during emergencies, major incidents, or security\-related crises.
* Ensure regular emergency drills, evacuation exercises, and crisis simulations are conducted across all properties.
* Review emergency responses following incidents and implement continuous improvement initiatives.


 Loss Prevention \& Investigations
   

  

* Develop Group\-wide loss prevention strategies to minimize financial loss, theft, fraud, and operational risks.
* Oversee investigations relating to theft, fraud, misconduct, accidents, security breaches, and other incidents.
* Ensure incident investigations are completed professionally, objectively, and in compliance with legal requirements.
* Monitor security trends and recommend preventive actions to reduce future incidents.


 Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure all properties comply with company security standards, policies, insurance requirements, and statutory regulations.
* Lead internal security audits and support external audits and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain oversight of Fire Life Safety compliance and associated documentation across the Group.
* Ensure security documentation, incident reporting, and investigation records meet legal and corporate standards.


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Monitor security operations across all hotels, restaurants, and hospitality venues.
* Ensure consistent implementation of patrol procedures, access control, CCTV monitoring, visitor management, key control, and Lost \& Found procedures.
* Develop and maintain Group security standards and operational manuals.
* Review property security staffing structures and recommend operational improvements.


 Leadership \& People Development
   

  

* Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Property Directors of Security, Security Managers, and security teams.
* Develop succession planning and career development programs for security professionals within the Group.
* Establish Group\-wide security training programs.
* Promote a strong safety and security culture throughout the organization.


 Financial Management
   

  

* Develop and manage the Group Security budget.
* Review and approve property security budgets and capital expenditure proposals.
* Monitor departmental expenditure to ensure cost efficiency while maintaining operational effectiveness.
* Evaluate return on investment for security technologies, systems, and initiatives.


 Technology \& Innovation
   

  

* Oversee Group\-wide security technology, including
+ CCTV systems
+ Access Control Systems
+ Alarm Monitoring
+ Visitor Management Systems
+ Incident Reporting Platforms

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and innovation.


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* Develop executive security dashboards and performance reports.
* Analyze incident trends and identify areas requiring corrective action.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Lead special security projects and initiatives as assigned by Executive Leadership.
* Travel regularly between TFG Hospitality properties to conduct reviews, audits, and operational support.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Bachelor's Degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Professional security certifications (CPP, PSP, PCI, CSMP, NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent) preferred.
* Minimum 10\-15 years of progressive security leadership experience within hospitality, luxury hotels, mixed\-use developments, or large corporate organizations.
* Minimum 5 years in a multi\-property or regional security leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of UAE health, safety, and security regulations (preferred).
* Experience managing crisis response, investigations, business continuity, and enterprise risk management.

data.jd_text:
**About Our Client** 




  





 Our client is a sophisticated, privately held single\-family office with a long\-term investment horizon and a global, multi\-asset class investment strategy. The office manages a diversified portfolio across public and private equities, real assets, fixed income, hedge funds, and direct investments.
 



  





 The organisation is committed to preserving and growing capital across generations while maintaining the highest standards of discretion, governance, and professionalism in all aspects of wealth stewardship.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




  





 Our client is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Investment Associate to support the investment team in managing and monitoring a diversified global portfolio. The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in investment analysis, portfolio monitoring, and operational due diligence, with the ability to work across multiple asset classes and collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders.
 



  





 This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute meaningfully to investment manager selection, asset allocation implementation, and overall investment governance while working within a high\-performing and collaborative investment environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Portfolio Monitoring \& Reporting** 




  




* Monitor portfolio performance, risk metrics, and asset allocation across multiple asset classes.
* Assist in the preparation of Investment Committee presentations, quarterly reports, and portfolio dashboards.
* Maintain accurate investment records and ensure the integrity of portfolio management data.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of portfolio reporting systems and automation tools in collaboration with external vendors.



  





**Investment Research \& Analysis** 




  




* Conduct investment research and support due diligence on opportunities across public equities, private equity, venture capital, hedge funds, private credit, real estate, and other alternative investments.
* Build and maintain detailed financial models, including valuation and LBO models where appropriate.
* Perform industry, company, and market research to support investment recommendations.
* Prepare investment memoranda and analytical reports for senior investment professionals.
* Monitor existing investments, review quarterly reports, and participate in meetings with investment managers and portfolio company management teams.



  





**Operational Support** 




  




* Coordinate capital calls, distributions, subscriptions, and fund documentation with custodians, administrators, and external service providers.
* Support legal, compliance, and operational processes relating to new investments and ongoing portfolio management.
* Assist in evaluating and implementing investment technology, reporting, and data management tools.
* Maintain accurate investment pipeline tracking and transaction status updates.



  





**Relationship Management** 




  




* Develop and maintain relationships with external investment managers, advisors, banks, and service providers.
* Maintain CRM records and assist with the coordination of investment meetings, conferences, and due diligence sessions.
* Prepare meeting materials, briefing notes, and summaries of investment manager interactions.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





**The successful candidate will possess:** 




  




* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* CFA, CAIA, ACA or progress towards a professional qualification would be advantageous.
* Approximately
 **3–5 years'** 
 experience within investment management, private equity, investment banking, management consulting, a family office, endowment, or institutional investment environment.
* Excellent financial modelling and advanced Excel skills, including LBO modelling.
* Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities with experience evaluating investments across multiple asset classes.
* Experience in real estate investing would be advantageous.
* Strong experience conducting investment fund manager due diligence and manager selection.
* Experience using Bloomberg, Addepar, FactSet, or similar investment platforms would be beneficial.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare high\-quality investment materials.
* High levels of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.
* Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working within a lean, high\-performing investment team.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

data.raw_snippet: Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for grow
data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.
