* Benchmark and implement the latest mobility technologies and service models, ensuring solutions are data\-driven and future\-ready.
* Collaborate across disciplines and geographies to deliver holistic, resilient, and sustainable transport solutions.
* Oversee the bidding process, technical scope development, and fee estimation for mobility projects.
* Manage project budgets, P\&L, and resource allocation to achieve financial targets.

* Demonstrable experience from consultancy, or industry that includes strong experience in developing mobility strategies and providing transport planning inputs to master planning and plot design schemes.

* Experience and a passion for Design Thinking and Human\-Centred Design.
* Project management experience in a consultancy environment is essential.
* Business development, bid writing and thought leadership skills will be essential.
* Experience dealing with uncertainty and have the ability to be flexible and adaptable to a working environment that is evolving in nature and requires varied project work and client demands.
* Someone who has team leadership skills and can build teams, mentor others through performance management and training and development.

SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will provide overall leadership and strategic direction for PMCM services on roads and bridges projects, acting as the primary point of accountability for project performance and client satisfaction. The role will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that all project objectives are achieved in line with contractual obligations and corporate standards.
   

  

 Subject to project award, the successful candidate will lead project planning, mobilization, execution, and close\-out activities, while establishing robust governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination processes. They will oversee project controls, construction supervision interfaces, consultant and contractor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The Project Director will also be expected to maintain strong relationships with clients, government authorities, contractors, and key stakeholders, while supporting business growth through opportunity identification, bid support, and strategic client engagement where required.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and direct PMCM delivery for major roads and bridges projects from inception through completion, subject to award.
* Serve as the senior client interface and ensure effective stakeholder management at all levels.
* Provide leadership to project managers, discipline leads, construction management teams, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor project delivery strategies, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Ensure effective management of scope, risk, change control, quality, HSE, and commercial performance.
* Oversee design coordination, construction supervision, contract administration, and project controls functions.
* Drive timely decision\-making and resolution of technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and company procedures.
* Prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, dashboards, and performance updates.
* Support recruitment, mentoring, and development of project team members.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and strategic positioning for future PMCM opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced infrastructure leader with a strong track record of delivering large, complex roads and bridges projects under PMCM or similar consultancy\-led delivery models. They will possess excellent leadership, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in demanding, high\-profile project environments.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure project delivery, with a strong emphasis on site\-based execution and project delivery leadership for major roads and bridges projects.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in managing projects through key delivery stages, including mobilization, construction supervision, interface management, testing and commissioning, project close\-out, and handover.
* Proven track record in leading the day\-to\-day delivery of large\-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring performance against programme, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.

* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary site teams and coordinate effectively across contractors, designers, client representatives, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
* GCC experience is mandatory.
* KSA experience is a strong advantage.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred or equivalent recognized professional accreditation.
* Strong knowledge of SHEQ principles, standards, and implementation practices across major infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated commitment to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality leadership, with the ability to embed a strong SHEQ culture across project teams and supply chain partners.
* Proven experience in promoting safe working practices, quality compliance, risk mitigation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.
* Strong understanding of contract administration, construction management, project controls, change management, and stakeholder coordination in live project environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong client\-facing presence and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and public\-sector entities.

**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description:**
 Aviagen is establishing a new world\-class operation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), comprising farms, a hatchery, a feed mill, a laboratory, and a decontamination facility across multiple locations.
   

  

 To support the successful delivery of this ambitious project, Aviagen has partnered with GPP, a specialist consulting firm with extensive expertise in the design, management, and supervision of poultry industry construction projects.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Supervisor** 
 to join the project team and work closely with both GPP and Aviagen stakeholders throughout the construction phase.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 Reporting to the Project Manager and Project Director, the Project Supervisor will be responsible for the day\-to\-day on\-site supervision of construction activities. Acting as the eyes and ears of the project management team, this role ensures that contractors execute works in accordance with approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.
   

  

 This is a predominantly field\-based role requiring a proactive individual with strong construction oversight experience and the ability to identify and resolve issues before they impact project delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Supervise and monitor the daily activities of contractors and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, contractual requirements, and project standards.
* Conduct routine site inspections and quality audits, documenting findings and following up on corrective actions where required.
* Serve as the primary on\-site liaison between contractors, suppliers, consultants, and the wider project management team.
* Track construction progress against project schedules and promptly escalate any delays, risks, or deviations.
* Support the implementation of corrective actions related to schedule, quality, safety, or cost performance.
* Assist with the review, verification, and acceptance of completed construction works and milestone achievements.
* Monitor the implementation of approved design changes and ensure all modifications are executed correctly on site.
* Maintain accurate site documentation, including daily reports, inspection records, photographic evidence, and progress updates.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable local regulations, building codes, permit requirements, and safety standards.
* Participate in site coordination meetings, safety briefings, audits, and project reviews.
* Provide accurate field information to support weekly and monthly project reporting.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure contractors adhere to established HSE requirements at all times.


**Required**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Minimum of 8 years' experience in construction supervision, site management, or project execution.
* Proven experience overseeing industrial, infrastructure, agricultural, or large\-scale construction projects.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, quality assurance processes, and health and safety standards.
* Experience working with contractors and suppliers within the Saudi Arabian market.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced site environment and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Fluent in both English and Arabic.


**Preferred**
* Experience in poultry, agribusiness, food production, or industrial facility construction projects.
* Knowledge of KSA construction regulations, permitting processes, and local standards.
* Familiarity with project management and reporting tools such as MS Project, SharePoint, or similar platforms.


 What We Offer
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the development of a flagship poultry operation in Saudi Arabia and contribute to one of the most significant investments in the region. You will work alongside international experts and gain exposure to large\-scale, technically complex agricultural and industrial construction projects.

data.raw_snippet:
**Role Overview**

 Run what already exists \- take direct ownership of currently live T\&M and Managed Services engage
data.jd_text:
**Role Overview**
 Build the infrastructure \- establish the governance, tooling, and process foundation for how recurring engagements will be mobilized, monitored, and billed going forward.
   

  

 Run what already exists \- take direct ownership of currently live T\&M and Managed Services engagements so that delivery continuity, SLA attainment, and billing are not disrupted while the infrastructure is being built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Infrastructure Build


 Stand up the SLA definition and agreement process for new Operational Managed Services engagements \- aligned to ISO/IEC 20000\-1 categories (availability, response time, resolution time, quality/output) in lines with the terms negotiated with clients that safeguard the company's interest.
   

  

 Establish the client enablement document template and process for T\&M engagements \- billable\-day definition, approval authority, exception handling, non\-withholding clause.
   

  

 Define the mobilization checklist and standard for both production (billable) and management staff \- covering client acceptance, rate/SLA confirmation, system access, and compliance documentation.
   

  

 Set up the Change Request (CR) governance process for Managed Services \- formal logging, classification, pricing against the Master Price List, and client acceptance before billing wherever applicable.
   

  

 Work to ensure all of the above is documented as a formal SOP, version\-controlled in the central SharePoint repository
   

  

* Live Engagement Management


 Take direct ownership of an assigned portfolio of active T\&M and/or Managed Services engagements immediately upon joining.
   

  

 Own the monthly timesheet governance cycle for T\&M engagements \- data preparation, Level\-1 and Level\-2 approval chase, daily rate application, and timely Delivery Note preparation.
   

  

 Monitor SLA attainment for Managed Services engagements in your portfolio \- track performance against agreed thresholds, escalate to Technology before a breach occurs, and produce the service period report.
   

  

 Manage the Delivery Note sign\-off cycle end\-to\-end \- reconcile to rate card/PO, obtain client signature, and hand over the signed DN package to Finance within the stipulated timelines.
   

  

 Act as the first escalation point for client\-side service issues, timesheet disputes, and delivery concerns within your portfolio.
   

  

 Flag and formally raise any engagement carrying unacceptable delivery risk \- including the right to recommend declining or restructuring high\-risk scope before commitment.
   

  

* Mobilization


 Coordinate the mobilization of new resources onto live engagements \- client acceptance of profiles, rate/SLA confirmation in writing, and compliance documentation (Iqama, GOSI, WPS enrolment) completed before Day 1 of billable work.
   

  

 Set up onsite and offshore delivery infrastructure for new mobilizations \- system access, VPN, workspace allocation, and working\-time framework \- confirmed and tested before go\-live.
   

  

 Coordinate with HR and Technology to ensure management and governance roles (not just production staff) are assigned and briefed before engagement start.
   

  

* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement


 Maintain real\-time visibility of utilization, recovery days, and SLA attainment across your portfolio \- feeding into the Portfolio Manager's aggregated view.
   

  

 Contribute engagement\-level data and lessons learned into the 90\-day capacity forecast and into future proposal costing.
   

  

 Identify recurring process gaps during live delivery and feed them back into the infrastructure build \- this role is expected to improve the SOPs it operates under, not just follow them.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Experience**
 6\-10 years of experience in IT services delivery, managed services operations, staffing/T\&M operations, or recurring service delivery.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience running live client engagements with commercial accountability \- not purely a project coordination background.
   

  

 Experience setting up a new process or function from scratch is strongly preferred \- this is as much a build role as a run role.
   

  

 Exposure to both onsite and offshore delivery models is an advantage, given the company's KSA, India, and Egypt footprint.
   

  

**Technical \& Functional Skills**
 Strong working knowledge of SLA frameworks \- familiarity with ISO/IEC 20000 or ITIL service management concepts preferred.
   

  

 Comfortable with timesheet, billing, and Delivery Note governance cycles \- understands the mechanics of how T\&M revenue is protected from leakage.
   

  

 Experience with ticketing or service management platforms (Fresh service, Jira Service Management, or equivalent) for CR and SLA tracking.
   

  

 Working knowledge of KSA labor compliance touchpoints \- Iqama, GOSI, WPS, Qiwa \- sufficient to coordinate with HR, not execute compliance directly.
   

  

**Behavioral \& Leadership Qualities**
 Comfortable holding two priorities simultaneously \- building new processes while keeping existing commitments running without disruption.
   

  

 Direct and proactive in escalating risk \- this role is expected to say no to unworkable commitments, not absorb risk silently.
   

  

 Strong written communication \- produces clean, factual service reports and escalation notes that a client or senior leadership can act on without rework.
   

  

 Works well under ambiguity without using that ambiguity as an excuse for delivery gaps.
   

  

**Certifications (preferred, Not Mandatory At Entry)**
 ITIL Foundation
   

  

 PMP or equivalent project/service management certification
   

  

 Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Bel

data.jd_text:
**About This Role**
 As an Associate Clinical Country \& Site Lead, you will be in an external\-facing, country\-aligned clinical operations position focused on providing key local operational and scientific knowledge to support country\-level clinical development strategy. You will help enable local partnerships, enhance customer satisfaction, and support the focused delivery and execution of Biogen’s development pipeline.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Director, Clinical Country \& Site Lead, as well as the Clinical Country \& Site Lead or Senior Clinical Country \& Site Lead in country, to provide study teams with detailed local operational and scientific knowledge that supports clinical operations execution. You will ensure that local opportunities, needs, and insights are thoughtfully integrated into operational plans.
   

  

 You will serve as a single point of contact for investigators, affiliate office staff, CRO staff, and QSDO/global teams, helping enable the delivery of local clinical trials with a strong focus on quality, patient safety, and oversight of CRO activities and performance.
   

  

 You will also act as a site escalation point for investigator concerns, including issues related to data integrity, data quality, patient safety, or matters unresolved by the CRO, ensuring these are communicated to the appropriate Biogen responsible party.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Maintain up\-to\-date local knowledge of Biogen’s therapeutic areas, standards of care, clinical trial requirements, and the needs of local investigators and research sites.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with investigators and sites, helping position Biogen as a partner of choice for clinical research.
* Support country and site selection activities by gathering local insights and feedback from investigators and other key stakeholders.
* Act as the primary country\-level QSDO/Biogen contact for sponsor oversight activities, including Sponsor Oversight Visits (SOVs), audits, inspections, and CRO oversight.
* Perform co\-monitoring activities during Sponsor Oversight Visits, ensuring trial records, informed consent documentation, and source documents are maintained in accordance with protocol, ICH\-GCP, SOPs, and local regulations.
* Lead interactions with investigators, affiliate teams, CRO staff, and global stakeholders to facilitate information flow and timely issue resolution across clinical studies.
* Monitor and assess overall trial and country performance to support QSDO objectives and country\-level goals.
* Contribute to local projects and broader Clinical Study Operations activities as a representative of the country.


**Who You Are**
 You are a collaborative and adaptable clinical research professional who thrives in a matrix environment. You bring strong relationship\-building skills, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. You are eager to learn, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on quality, patient safety, and stakeholder experience. Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to clinical research and help bring innovative medicines to patients.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* University degree or the equivalent combination of education with a science background and experience required.
* Minimum 5 years clinical research experience. Experience managing clinical trial activities desirable, especially sponsor oversight activities in an outsourced /FSP model with CROs/vendors.
* Understanding of cross\-functional drug development process and high scientific/clinical knowledge across key therapeutic areas enabling aCCSL to discuss compound (s), development plans, and protocol endpoints with investigator site personnel.
* Understanding of ICH/GCP, applicable country regulations and clinical trial monitoring in an outsourced model.
* Strong organizational skills, especially project management skills, with an ability to set clear goals, align priorities and execute on multiple tasks/activities.
* Effective working knowledge of relevant IT tools to promote virtual team working.
* Excellent knowledge of clinical operational activities/challenges across local geography.
* Ideal candidate will be customer\-focused, with excellent interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, high emotional intelligence and a collaborative decision\-making approach. Must build relationships throughout and across the organization whilst operating remotely.
* Proven ability to handle a high volume of tasks of varying complexity within a given timeframe and in consideration of relative priorities.  Strong communication skills, including English language skill in countries where English is not the primary language. Ability to assimilate new knowledge rapidly.


 Job Level: Management
   

  

**Why Biogen?**
 We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid\-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well\-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.
   

  

 At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E\-Verify Employer in the United States.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Director of IT/OT Network \& Security Operations** 
 is a critical leadership role within City Operations IT, responsible for the end\-to\-end management, reliability, and security of Qiddiya's converged IT and Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure.
   

  

 As Qiddiya transitions from construction to operations, this role will lead operational readiness, infrastructure acceptance, and the ongoing management of city\-wide digital platforms, including fiber networks, active network equipment, smart city systems, and physical security networks (VMS, ACS, CCTV).
   

  

 The role serves as a key bridge between enterprise IT and industrial OT environments, ensuring seamless integration, high availability, and a robust cybersecurity posture across all city operations. It requires deep technical expertise in network architecture and security, alongside strong vendor management and cross\-functional leadership to collaborate effectively with QTECH, MDU, District Master Developers, and third\-party operators.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Operational Leadership \& Strategy
* Lead the IT/OT Network and Security Operations function for Qiddiya City IT Operations.
* Define and execute the operational strategy for converged IT/OT environments, aligned with the City Operations Target Operating Model (TOM) and Qiddiya's digital vision.
* Establish and manage interfaces with the Network Operations Center (NOC) and Security Operations Center (SOC) for city\-level infrastructure.
* Define, monitor, and enforce SLAs, KPIs, and performance metrics across internal teams and external service providers.
* Infrastructure \& Network Operations
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations, maintenance, and optimization of city\-wide network infrastructure, including fiber backbone, MMRs, MDCs, and active network components.
* Manage the operational lifecycle of OT networks supporting smart city use cases across utilities, transportation, and facility management.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, and redundancy of critical network topologies supporting city operations.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex IT/OT network issues.
* Security Operations \& Governance
* Oversee operational security systems and their supporting network infrastructure.
* Implement and monitor cybersecurity controls across OT environments, including network segregation, access control, and threat detection, aligned with QTECH cybersecurity standards.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security audits for city infrastructure.
* Ensure compliance with national cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NCA) and internal Qiddiya policies.
* Transition, Handover \& Acceptance
* Act as the primary City Operations IT authority for the acceptance and handover of network and security infrastructure from QTECH, MDU, and District Master Developers.
* Define operational readiness criteria, testing protocols, and documentation standards for onboarding new assets.
* Participate in design reviews to ensure operational, maintainability, and security requirements are embedded early in the lifecycle.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
* Manage relationships and operational contracts with neutral hosts, data center operators, and managed service providers.
* Collaborate closely with QTECH Design teams to ensure alignment on architecture, shared services, and governance frameworks.
* Engage with Business Units (e.g., Transport, Utilities, Security) to ensure IT/OT infrastructure meets operational and use\-case requirements


**Requirements**
****Education****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.


**Experience**
* 12\-15 years of progressive experience in network engineering, IT/OT operations, and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record in managing large\-scale, mission\-critical infrastructure within complex environments such as smart cities, giga\-projects, utilities, or industrial sectors.
* Extensive experience bridging IT and OT environments, with a strong understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, and IoT network architectures.
* Demonstrated experience in transitioning infrastructure from construction and delivery phases into stable, live operations.


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Deep expertise in network routing, switching, and topology design (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent technologies).
* Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
* Experience with physical security network infrastructure, including CCTV, VMS, and ACS systems.
* Relevant industry certifications are highly desirable, such as:
+ Networking: CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent.
+ Security: CISSP, CISM, GICSP, or equivalent.
+ Service Management: ITIL v4\.


****Core Competencies****
* Strategic thinker with strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams and executive leadership.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and evolving environments.
* Strong vendor management and contract negotiation expertise

The Associate Director, Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineering is responsible for leading the execution, implementation, operational stability, resilience, automation, and cost optimization of Digital infrastructure and DevOps foundations across all Qiddiya Digital assets. This role acts as the Digital execution owner for infrastructure services, cloud environments, DevOps enablement, automation, observability foundations, infrastructure reliability, operational readiness, and infrastructure cost management. The role ensures that Digital infrastructure and platform services are implemented, maintained, and operated in alignment with Qiddiya enterprise cloud guidelines, cybersecurity requirements, architecture standards, compliance policies, and governance frameworks. This role does not own Qiddiya's enterprise cloud strategy, enterprise cloud governance, company\-wide cloud standards, application development, or application maintenance. These responsibilities remain with the relevant central Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, and application delivery teams. Instead, this role is accountable for translating enterprise cloud and infrastructure guidelines into practical execution across Digital environments, vendors, infrastructure services, DevOps tooling, deployment foundations, production readiness, and platform operations. This is a senior technical leadership role requiring strong infrastructure depth, DevOps execution experience, vendor governance, operational ownership, and the ability to drive Restricted This document has been classified as Restricted by Samy Baili reliable, secure, scalable, automated, and cost\-efficient Digital infrastructure across multiple System Integrators and delivery teams.

*

* Ensure Digital workloads are implemented in line with approved QIC technology standards, security policies, compliance requirements, and operational controls
* Drive consistency across Digital environments, including development, SIT, UAT, staging, pre\-production, production, and hotfix environments

* Drive automation of infrastructure provisioning, environment setup, configuration management, deployment support, and operational tasks

* Partner with DevSecOps teams to ensure infrastructure services are integrated into CI/CD pipelines, release governance, security gates, and deployment workflows
* Ensure Digital environments support faster, safer, and more predictable delivery without compromising compliance, security, or operational stability.
* Identify and remove infrastructure, environment, and deployment bottlenecks impacting Digital delivery teams.
* Drive standardization of DevOps practices across vendors, System Integrators, and Digital technology teams. Infrastructure Reliability \& Resilience
* Own the reliability, resilience, stability, and operational health of Digital infrastructure and platform services
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, backup, failover, recovery, and capacity practices are implemented and tested across Digital assets.

* Reduce infrastructure\-related incidents, environment instability, deployment blockers, and operational risks

* Avoid duplication of enterprise cloud governance by keeping the role focused on Digital execution, operationalization, and run management. FinOps \& Cost Management
* Own Digital infrastructure cost visibility, optimization, and accountability.

****Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project, it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up, Qiddiya is calling for you.****
**Position Summary**
 The Director of Viaduct, Stations and Tunnels (VST) leads the client\-side delivery of this D\&B package of civil infrastructure, including viaducts, stations, tunnels, shafts, portals, and associated works. The role is responsible for the successful planning, integrated design, delivery, testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness of the package associated with a major new metro railway programme.
   

  

 The role will act as the Owner's lead representative for all Viaduct, Stations and Tunnels scope, ensuring that they are coordinated and integrated with the DRSS package and that the metro system overall is delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with operational, technical, regulatory, and programme requirements.
   

  

 A key challenge of the role is managing complex interfaces between railway systems, civil infrastructure, operational assets, utility providers, government stakeholders, developers, future operators, and contractors within a rapidly developing city where some surrounding infrastructure is operational while other assets remain under design and construction.
   

  

 The VST Director works closely with the separate Depot, Rolling Stock and Systems (DRSS) package to achieve the overall integrated delivery outcome across both packages, and subsequent delivery to the Operator/Maintainer. This includes managing complex design interfaces across packages, regulatory bodies, utility providers and adjacent asset owners.
   

  

 The role also leads, develops, and supports a high\-performing team, setting clear expectations, building capability, and fostering a collaborative culture focused on safety, accountability, and successful project outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead delivery of all VST civil infrastructure works, ensuring compliance with scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives
* Oversee contractor performance, construction progress, risk management, and change control
* Manage interfaces between civil works, systems, rolling stock, utilities, existing infrastructure, and third\-party stakeholders
* Build and maintain relationships with government entities, regulatory authorities, utility providers, and developers
* Ensure construction delivery aligns with approved designs, operational requirements, and asset handover objectives
* Drive resolution of technical, contractual, stakeholder, and construction\-related issues
* Support testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and transition into operations
* Provide executive reporting, governance, and strategic decision\-making support


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline
* Minimum 20 years of experience in major infrastructure delivery, including 15 years in senior leadership roles
* Proven experience delivering metro, railway, or major transportation infrastructure projects, including stations, tunnels, and elevated structures
* Experience working within the Middle East region
* Strong expertise in programme delivery, interface management, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and contract administration
* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional accreditation preferred
* Experience in client\-side leadership roles and mega\-projects exceeding USD 4 billion is highly desirable

 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.
   

  

 — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team.

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Purpose
 
 Execute the main procurement activities including Sourcing, contracting and supplier developments in addition to Purchasing requested materials, Services, Assets, MRO and General Purchasing with right specifications, price, quality, and delivery time / right location from right source
 


 Key Accountability Areas
 
  Supplier Development and Evaluation:
 


* Develop suppliers to meet objectives related to cost savings, delivery performance, and materials quality.
* Perform regular supplier performance evaluations to establish supplier development plans, including development and sourcing\-related activities.
* Visit suppliers for required prequalification, evaluate, develop suppliers, and strengthen business partnerships in coordination with the commodity head and business unit (BU) quality teams.



 Sourcing and Contracting:
 


* Execute sourcing and contracting plans based on the AED sourcing strategy.
* Maximize the number of contracted items within the scope of work with approved suppliers to secure prices, delivery, payment terms, and quality while saving purchasing cycle time.
* Ensure commercial, legal, and contractual compliance in all procurement transactions.



 Procurement Execution:
 


* Understand detailed requirements for each purchase request, including description, specifications, quantity, UOM, and delivery date, with alignment and coordination with requesters or related BU technical teams.
* Manage the execution of purchase requests through processing RFx (RFQ, RFI, etc.) from the identified source list (Approved/Qualified suppliers).
* Negotiate for the best purchase conditions, considering required specifications, delivery time, and cost elements (lower price, best delivery date, best Incoterm/payment term).



 Materials and Specifications Management:
 


* Initiate alternative material specifications according to market availability with the involvement of related BU technical teams.
* Compare quotations based on the approved comparison form, considering the best commercial (landed cost) and delivery terms.
* Identify selected suppliers with the involvement of BU\-related technical teams/requesters (if required) and issue Purchase Orders (POs) on the system to the winning supplier based on winner criteria.



 Purchase Order Management:
 


* Ensure the PO has all required attached documents (Quotations, communications, etc.).
* Follow the Alfanar PO approval matrix to obtain the final approved order.
* Send approved purchase orders to suppliers and follow up to receive order acknowledgment.
* Follow the PO delivery schedule with suppliers and related departments (Inbound Logistics) until materials arrive and the order is closed by paying the supplier.



 Procurement Coordination and Vendor Management:
 


* Effectively contribute to procurement activities (Sourcing, Development, Evaluation, Contracting) with required coordination with related commodity heads.
* Maintain vendor master information and ensure it is up to date.
* Manage non\-conformity processes for rejected supplied materials, and lead corrective/preventive actions with the involvement of other related departments (Quality, Store, Finance, etc.).

 HR Proficiency:
 


* Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job

 Delivery:

 Problem\-Solving:
 


* Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.



 Quality:
 


* Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.



 Business Process Improvements:
 


* Coordinate well\-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.



 Compliance:
 


* Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions.



 Health, Safety, and Environment:
 


* Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high\-quality products/services.

At Deewan, www.deewan.sa, we're on a mission to reinvent how businesses connect, collaborate, and communicate. Born in Saudi Arabia and built for the digital age, we fuse breakthrough technology with deep industry expertise to create secure, scalable, and intelligent communication platforms that drive real business results.
   

  

 Our partner network spans the MEA region with international access to messaging hubs worldwide. Our clients include major banks, financial institutions, digital payment providers, OTT applications, government authorities, healthcare, education, and other key industry verticals.
   

  

 If you have a passion for winning and are ready to challenge yourself every day in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment — Deewan is where you belong
   

  

 We are looking for a driven and results\-oriented Sales Executive to join Deewan's growing sales team in Riyadh. This is a pure hunting role, as a single contributer,. Your primary mission is to identify, engage, and close new medium to large customers for Deewan's CPaaS and SaaS communication solutions.
   

  

 You will leverage your existing market knowledge, industry network, and consultative selling skills to open new doors and build a strong pipeline of high\-value opportunities. This is a high\-impact, individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives on the thrill of winning new business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**New Business Development (Core Focus)**
* Proactively hunt, identify, and acquire new medium to large clients across target sectors (Banking, Fintech, Government, Healthcare, Retail, etc.)
* Build and manage a robust pipeline through cold outreach, networking, referrals, events, and market intelligence
* Conduct discovery meetings and present tailored CPaaS/SaaS solutions that address each prospect's specific communication challenges
* Own the full sales cycle — from first contact through to contract signature


**Sales Targets \& Revenue**
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual new business revenue targets
* Maintain accurate pipeline records and provide regular forecasts using CRM tools
* Report on sales activity, pipeline health, and deal progress to the Head of Sales


**Consultative Selling \& Solution Alignment**
* Develop a deep understanding of Deewan's product portfolio and articulate clear value propositions to C\-level and senior decision\-makers
* Map client business needs to Deewan solutions and collaborate with internal teams (pre\-sales, product, delivery) to craft compelling proposals


**Market Intelligence**
* Stay up to date with trends, competitors, and regulatory developments in the Saudi CPaaS/SaaS landscape
* Share market insights and prospect feedback with leadership to inform product and go\-to\-market strategy


**Contract Negotiation \& Closing**
* Lead commercial negotiations and close agreements on terms that are favorable for both the client and Deewan
* Ensure smooth handover to account management and delivery teams post\-signature


**Requirements**
**Required**
* Minimum 2\-5 years of proven new business (hunter) sales experience in CPaaS, SaaS, Telecommunications, or a closely related technology sector
* Strong, demonstrable track record of selling to medium to large clients in Saudi Arabia
* Deep familiarity with the KSA market: key sectors, buying behaviors, and decision\-making processes
* Existing network of medium to large account contacts in the KSA market is a strong advantage
* Experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles


**Preferred**
* Prior exposure to CPaaS products such as SMS, WhatsApp Business, RCS, OTP, voice, or omnichannel communication platforms
* Arabic \& English language proficiency (spoken and written)
* Experience working with government, banking, fintech, or healthcare sectors in KSA


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Hunter mentality — self\-motivated, tenacious, and hungry to win new business
* Excellent consultative selling and solution\-mapping abilities
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in Arabic and/or English
* Ability to engage and influence at C\-level and senior stakeholder levels
* High commercial acumen and ability to build a business case for clients
* Proficient in CRM software (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite
* Strong organizational skills — ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
* Ethical, professional, and a strong team player


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or a related field
* A relevant professional certification or MBA is a plus, but not mandatory

**About Four Seasons**
 Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world\-class employee experience and company culture.
   

  

 At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.
   

  

**About the location:**
 An architectural icon in the heart of Saudi Arabia’s vibrant capital soaring over the city in the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is a buzzing hub at the forefront of style and sophistication. Redesigned interiors bring authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship to life, while our distinguished team provides a bespoke experience through thoughtful, personalized service and hospitality.
   

  

 The Role of the Director of Commercial
   

  

 As Director of Commercial, you will play a key leadership role in driving the overall commercial strategy and business performance of Four Seasons Riyadh Hotel. You will be responsible for maximizing revenue, market share, brand positioning, and profitability across all commercial functions including Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, Reservations, Public Relations, and Digital Marketing.
   

  

 This role requires a strategic and visionary leader who can develop and execute innovative commercial initiatives aligned with Four Seasons brand standards and the hotel’s business objectives. You will work closely with the General Manager, and Regional Commercial teams to ensure strong market presence, revenue growth, and exceptional guest engagement across all business segments.
   

  

 As part of the hotel’s executive leadership team, you will contribute to the overall success of the property by leading high\-performing teams, building strong client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and positioning the hotel as one of the leading ultra\-luxury destinations in the region.
   

  

 You will oversee all commercial strategies related to transient, group, leisure, wholesale, and corporate business while ensuring strong collaboration between operational and commercial departments to deliver exceptional guest experiences and financial results.
   

  

 Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh
   

  

 Prime location in the heart of the capital, nestled within the iconic 99\-storey Kingdom Tower. Situated at such a prestigious address, the hotel offers unparalleled proximity to key business areas, shopping centres, and cultural sites, featuring 276 spacious and light\-filled rooms, including 39 luxurious suites.
   

  

 Food \& Beverage
   

  

 The hotel offers exceptional dining experiences across multiple restaurant venues, delivering elevated culinary concepts and personalized service standards synonymous with Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
   

  

 Meetings \& Events
   

  

 Our event facilities, with a mix of Ballroom and Meeting Rooms, offer remarkable event spaces suitable for a wide range of corporate and social events.
   

  

 SPA and Wellness
   

  

 Nestled within the hotel, our world\-class spa offers luxurious wellness experiences alongside premium fitness facilities designed to deliver relaxation and rejuvenation for our guests.
   

  

 Area of Responsibility
   

  

 Commercial Strategy \& Leadership
   

  

* Develop and execute the resort’s overall commercial strategy aligned with business objectives and Four Seasons standards.
* Lead and manage the Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, Reservations, and PR teams.
* Identify new revenue opportunities and business segments to maximize profitability and market share.
* Drive forecasting, budgeting, and commercial planning processes.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and business performance to develop strategic action plans.
* Ensure alignment between operational and commercial teams to achieve business goals.


 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, partners, luxury travel advisors, and corporate clients.
* Oversee sales activities across all market segments including leisure, corporate, wholesale, and group business.
* Support international sales trips, trade shows, client events, and networking opportunities.
* Ensure achievement of sales targets and revenue objectives.


 Marketing \& Brand Positioning
   

  

* Oversee marketing, branding, digital presence, and public relations strategies.
* Ensure all marketing initiatives reflect Four Seasons brand standards and positioning.
* Collaborate with regional and corporate teams on campaigns and promotional activities.
* Drive brand awareness and positioning within key luxury travel markets.


 Revenue Management \& Reservations
   

  

* Oversee pricing strategies, forecasting, inventory management, and distribution channels.
* Ensure effective revenue optimization across rooms, F\&B, spa, and other revenue streams.
* Monitor business pace and market demand to adjust strategies accordingly.
* Support reservations and distribution operations to maximize conversion and guest satisfaction.


 Knowledge and Skills
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 7–10 years of commercial leadership experience within luxury hospitality.
* Strong background in Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, and business development.
* Proven leadership and team management skills.
* Strong analytical, financial, and strategic planning abilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality market trends and customer expectations.
* Ability to build strong relationships internally and externally.
* Experience with hotel systems, revenue management tools, and CRM platforms preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.


 What to Expect

**Job Title** 
 : Cards Portfolio Manager
   

  

**Employment type** 
 : Contract (On\-site)
   

  

**Contract length** 
 : 12 months
   

  

**Location** 
 : KSA
   

  

**PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT**
 The Cards Portfolio Manager is responsible for managing, optimizing, and growing the bank's credit, debit, and prepaid card portfolio. The role focuses on driving portfolio profitability, customer engagement, and lifecycle performance through data\-driven strategies, while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
   

  

 The position plays a critical role in achieving key business KPIs across acquisition, activation, spend, retention, and risk management.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
 Portfolio Strategy \& Performance Management:
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end performance of the card's portfolio, including credit, debit, and prepaid card products.
* Monitor key KPIs such as activation rates, spend per card, utilization, attrition, and profitability.
* Develop and implement strategies to grow portfolio revenue and optimize customer value.
* Track portfolio trends and provide insights to senior management through regular reporting.


 Customer Lifecycle \& Campaign Management:
   

  

* Design and execute customer lifecycle strategies (acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention).
* Lead targeted campaigns using segmentation and personalization to increase engagement and spend.
* Manage end\-to\-end campaign execution including planning, tracking, and performance evaluation.
* Drive initiatives to reduce dormancy and improve reactivation rates.


 Product Development \& Innovation:
   

  

* Support development and launch of new card products, features, and value propositions.
* Work closely with payment network partners on product enhancements
* Identify opportunities for innovation (digital payments, e\-commerce, cross\-border usage).


 Data Analytics \& Insights:
   

  

* Analyze portfolio data to identify customer behavior trends and growth opportunities
* Use insights to optimize pricing, credit limits, and usage strategies.
* Prepare dashboards and MIS reports to monitor portfolio health and campaign performance.
* Provide actionable insights to improve decision\-making and business outcomes.


 Risk, Compliance \& Governance:
   

  

* Monitor credit risk indicators (e.g., delinquency rates, loss ratios) and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with SAMA regulations and internal policies.
* Balance growth objectives with risk appetite and portfolio quality.


 Stakeholder Management:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Risk, Marketing, Finance, Operations, IT).
* Liaise with payment networks and external partners to support business initiatives.
* Present portfolio performance, strategies, and recommendations to senior leadership.


**Knowledge and Experience:**
* 5 \- 7 years' experience in portfolio management within cards.
* Proven experience working in Saudi Arabia (knowledge of local market and SAMA regulations preferred).
* Strong knowledge of credit, debit, and prepaid card products and lifecycle strategies
* Experience in GCC banking environment is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Deep understanding of card economics and payment ecosystems.
* Portfolio and lifecycle management expertise.
* Strategic thinking with strong commercial acumen.
* Stakeholder management and communication skills.

data.jd_text:
Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

 Miza is one of those ventures building a digital wealth management platform on a mission to democratize access to exclusive global investment opportunities. We provide high\-net\-worth individuals with access to top\-tier private funds, pre\-IPO deals, and alternative investments opportunities traditionally gated by high minimums and opaque networks. We are reimagining the private wealth experience through a hybrid of cutting\-edge technology and curated investment access. This is not a traditional brokerage this is a platform where HNWIs can effortlessly participate in some of the world's most compelling private funds across multiple asset classes.
   

  

 We are looking for a Managing Investments Associate (CME1 and CME4 required) to take real ownership across portfolio construction, fund operations, and counterparty management from day one reporting directly to the CEO.
   

  

**THE ROLE What You'll Own Here.**
 Counterparty Management
   

  

* Day\-to\-day handling of relationships with external partners fund houses, custodians, distribution platforms, and global asset managers
* Coordinate execution and operational flows across counterparties; ensure subscriptions, redemptions, and capital calls are handled cleanly and on time
* Serve as Miza's point of contact for routine operational and investment queries from these partners Portfolio Construction \& Screening
* Support the investment team in screening funds, managers, and strategies for inclusion in client portfolios
* Build and maintain the investment universe, due diligence packs, comparative analyses, and fee benchmarking
* Run periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing analyses Investment Writing
* Produce investment memos, fund summaries, market commentaries, and client\-facing investment notes
* Translate technical investment content between English and Arabic for client communications
* Maintain quality and consistency across all investment documentation Fund Operations \& Dealing
* Support trade execution across asset classes funds, equities, and fixed income
* Reconcile positions, confirmations, and settlements with the operations team
* Help maintain and improve internal investment processes as Miza scales


 How Success Will Be Measured Accuracy and timeliness of counterparty operations, quality and consistency of investment documentation, contribution to portfolio construction and screening, and reliability across fund operations as Miza scales.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Managing Investments Associate → Senior Investments seat as Miza scales its platform and client base across the region.
   

  

**THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if…**
 You have 2–3 years of relevant experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or investment operations
   

  

 You hold CME1 and CME4 certifications (mandatory)
   

  

 You're fluent in Arabic and English written and spoken
   

  

 You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with numbers, fund documentation, and reconciliations
   

  

 You've demonstrated the ability to use AI tools to improve real workflows, not just for drafting
   

  

 Bonus: experience in private markets, alternative investments, or global funds; background in a CMA\-regulated environment
   

  

**THE ENVIRONMENT What Working Here Actually Looks Like.**
 1\- IC\-First Ownership You execute without a layer of management around you. This is a role for someone who takes initiative and follows through without needing to be managed.
   

  

 2\- Direct Impact on the Business Small mistakes here compound, so reliability is non\-negotiable. What you do or don't do moves the business directly.
   

  

 3\- A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into a senior investments seat as Miza scales its platform and expands its client base across the region.
   

  

 What You Get From Us
   

  

 Meaningful work from day one: You won't be a cog
   

  

 you will shape how this business runs. Real autonomy: Freedom from bureaucracy and the trust to own your function. Exposure to global private markets: Access to top\-tier private funds, pre\-IPO deals, and alternative investments at the frontier of wealth management in Saudi Arabia. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the CEO and founding team. An accelerated curve: You'll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.
   

  

 Hiring Process Introductory recruiter conversation → CEO interview → Technical investment exercise → Reference checks → Offer

**Position Summary** 

 The Assistant Director of Catering Sales supports the Director in managing the catering sales department to achieve revenue goals and maintain high service standards. This role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the sales team, managing key accounts, and ensuring that all sales processes—from lead inquiry to final execution—are handled with precision. The successful candidate will act as a mentor to junior staff and take the lead on special projects to improve department efficiency.
 


**Key Responsibilities**

 Assist the Director in supervising the sales team, providing day\-to\-day guidance on lead conversion, contract negotiation, and upselling techniques.
* **Operational Oversight:** 
 Review all Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and contracts for accuracy before they are circulated to the operations and culinary teams. Ensure all departmental SOPs are strictly followed.
* **Key Account Management:** 
 Directly manage a portfolio of high\-value corporate and social clients, ensuring consistent engagement and retention.
* **Reporting \& Analysis:** 
 Compile weekly and monthly sales reports for the Director. Analyze performance data to identify gaps in the pipeline and suggest adjustments to sales strategies.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** 
 Act as the liaison between the sales department and the kitchen/operations teams. Lead weekly team briefings to ensure all departments are prepared for upcoming events.
* **Process Improvement:** 
 Identify areas for improvement in existing sales workflows and lead the implementation of new systems or digital tools to streamline client communication.


**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 4–6 years of progressive experience in catering/event sales, with at least 1\-2 years in a senior or team lead capacity.
* **Skills:**
* **Advanced Negotiation:** 
 Proven ability to close complex contracts and handle difficult client negotiations.
* **Leadership:** 
 Demonstrated experience in training team members and managing performance.
* **Financial Literacy:** 
 Strong understanding of P\&L impact, catering margins, and revenue forecasting.
* **Technical Proficiency:** 
 Advanced knowledge of CRM software and MS Office; experience with hospitality systems is essential.
* **Adaptability:** 
 Ability to step into the Director’s role as needed and handle high\-level escalations calmly.


**Working Conditions** 
* This is a full\-time, high\-engagement role requiring flexibility to work during events, which may include evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Requires a balance between high\-level management and active, on\-the\-floor presence during major events.

**About you:**



* Bachelors Degree or Equivalent with minimum 10\+ years of job\-related experience.

* Minimum 10 years professional experience in pre and post contract functions in large International airport (\>20 MAP) projects or large multi\-phase projects.(Experience in operational airport environment preferred).

 As part of the Short \& Medium Range Air Defense Systems Product Area within the Land and Air Defense Systems (L\&ADS) Strategic Business Unit, the team has successfully delivered NASAMS systems to Qatar and is now transitioning into operations and sustainment, with opportunities for product modernization.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will report to the NASAMS Program Director within the MRAD Directorate and collaborate closely with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager based in Andover, MA. Serving as the primary point of contact for Qatar NASAMS execution efforts in Doha, you will work in partnership with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager to ensure a unified approach to program execution.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing subcontractor execution schedules with the KDA in\-country Project Manager to meet delivery commitments, supporting the CONUS Program Manager in preparing EACs and Program Review packages, and maintaining program infrastructure. This requires coordination across Raytheon functions, off\-sites, and international partners to ensure timely staffing, start\-up, and delivery of contractual products and services.
   

  

 You will lead in\-country teams for modernization, warranty, after\-sales support, repair \& return, and technical assistance, with responsibility for schedule and performance. This high\-visibility role involves daily interaction with the MRAD Directorate, regional and CONUS\-based functions, and senior\-level customer representatives, ensuring program success through cross\-functional collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This accompanied role will be in Doha, Qatar for a 2\-year international assignment on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with potential extension.
   

  

 Ability to travel internationally (up to 25%) as needed.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments including comprehensive post\-offer medical examination.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Oversee daily execution of the in\-country team, schedule, and performance for assigned contracts, ensuring compliance and fostering customer intimacy to support growth efforts.
* Serve as the primary operational Point of Contact for QEADF, providing procurement guidance, sustainment support, technical troubleshooting, and resource allocation for NASAMS Tactical Operations in Qatar.
* Direct in\-country team members, including site leads, warranty/logistics, quality, and technical personnel, to ensure maximum operational readiness for QEADF.
* Build strong partnerships with the major OCONUS subcontractor KDA, acting as the primary liaison between the NASAMS program office and subcontractor leadership.
* Drive timely resolution of issues, ensuring Raytheon and subcontractor concerns are addressed promptly.
* Support contract proposals, including bidding, negotiation, definitization, and start\-up processes.
* Develop and maintain a collaborative relationship with the QEAF customer, providing regular program updates and coordinating expectations with OCONUS and CONUS teams.
* Ensure subcontractor commitments meet financial, technical, and schedule requirements, escalating issues to the CONUS Program Manager as needed.
* Collaborate with internal functions, such as MRAD, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Supply Chain, and Quality, to enhance program success.
* Manage subcontractor lifecycle deliverables and support customer program reviews and visits.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate the in\-country team to achieve program objectives while fostering a culture aligned with corporate vision and values.


**Qualifications You Must Have**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and 12\+ years of relevant experience or an Advanced degree and minimum 10\+ years of experience.
* PMX Certification Level 4, or ability to obtain within 12 months.
* CORE certification or process improvement equivalent.
* 7\+ years of experience in Program Management and Risk \& Opportunity Measures.
* Experience with large Air Defense weapon systems and prior military.
* Experience in program execution across System Integration, Fielding, Training, Operations, and Sustainment.
* Experience with financial analysis tools and project management tools and/or systems.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to effectively lead a cross\-functional team in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work with international customers.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required.
* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


**Qualifications We Prefer**
* MBA or a graduate degree in engineering.
* Experience working in MENA region.
* Experience as a Senior Non\-commissioned Officer.
* Experience in international program execution, including collaboration with large international subcontractors and US Government programs.
* Strong working knowledge of EX/IM regulations, security requirements, and subcontract formation, execution, and management.
* Skilled in developing and reviewing cost proposals, as well as preparing Proposal Review and Contract Start\-up packages for management approval.
* Expertise in supporting development, production, sustainment, and execution of complex weapon systems, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry.
* Proficient in using Program Management tools or equivalent systems.
* NASAMS program experience in execution or capture phases.


**What We Offer**
 Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
   

  

**Clearance Information:** 
 This position requires security clearance. The Defense Industrial Security Clearance Office (DISCO), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
* Responsible for implementation of Target Operating Model (TOM) across the International Branches and Subsidiaries
* Conduct Domain Assessment, Evaluation and Gap Analysis, Regulatory requirements, and report periodically
* Support EVP / direct manager in governance implementation and day\-to\-day governance responsibilities over branches and subsidiaries.
* Assist in reviewing and implementing Policies \& Procedures re\-engineering,
* Coordinate various projects to grow the usage of the Group’s International banking branches / products in line with corporate initiatives.
* Assist in implementing Quality assurance framework in all designated countries.
* Support Domain Owner to Control and Monitor all ongoing implementation of new products, systems and processes in designated countries.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Provide required information to Domain Owner to Create Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes pertaining to the services / activities performed by the branches and subsidiaries.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Central Operations Relationship Management
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Instruct and co\-ordinate with the related user departments and International Branches to secure the requirements and schedule for the respective projects/facilities maintenance works execution.
* Co\-ordinate with the Domain Owner plan Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Provide required support to international branches/subsidiaries in TOM implementation roll\-out plan in respect to products implementation, operational training and guidance,
* Gather Country specific requirements from international branches/subsidiaries in initiation of new business opening.
* Review Business Requirements draft \& branch procedures received from related parties and provide review input and obtain approvals from stakeholders when required.
* Ensure International branches/subsidiaries are reporting Daily, Weekly and Monthly operational activities, monitor the reports, and take necessary action if required.
* Monitor and escalate compliance related issues to Group Compliance and communicate Business decision to relevant international unit.
* Coordinate in all banking projects for various corporate initiatives including acquisition conversions, systems changes, new products, services, and product enhancements.
* Ensure direct oversight of high\-volume activity, consistently complex issues and/ or high\-level risk and exposure items that have a significant impact on the achievement of the objectives of the department and potentially the International Operations Department.
* Support in efficiency management, quality improvement, and system optimization projects.
* Effectively interact with other operating units, managers and stakeholders.
* Coordinate and guide International Branches and Subsidiaries to take necessary action on Internal/External audit observation, recommendation within target date until closure.
* Periodic visit to international branches and assess respective domains are in line. Continuous improvement
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Provide direct support and guidance to project managers, supervisors, and analysts to international branch users.
* Maintain a high level of knowledge about electronic banking, Core Banking and its processes, international regulations, and generally accepted operating practices. Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your team's overall performance on a regular basis.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need\-to\-know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors University graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or Information Technology (related field of study), Masters preferred
* 10 years of experience of Electronic Banking \& Operations experience of which at least 5 years in managing International Operations.
* Full Banking Operational knowledge and experiences to guide all International Branches from opening to going live and continuous support.
* Full Compliance expertise to meet Regulatory requirements in International Branches
* High\-level document writing capability such as, Business requirements, Procedure and guidance document for all products and Branches position levels.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport
* Educational Certificates
